faq.q: Can I make a YouTube Shorts ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear picture, describe one action, and choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The credit cost shows before you start.

faq.q: Is this the same as a skippable in-stream ad?
faq.a: No. This page is for a tall Shorts file. A 16:9 in-stream ad is a separate wide file. Do not crop a wide ad and use it as a Short.

faq.q: Do Shorts ads need a creator or narration?
faq.a: No. You do not book a creator. The file has no voice track, music or captions. If a person appears, that presenter is generated, not a real customer.

faq.q: What does a Short cost in credits?
faq.a: A clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the price shows before you start. If a file fails, those credits return on their own.
Yes. You write the action, choose the length, and can make another file with a different scene. You choose which opening to publish.

faq.q: Are AI clips allowed in YouTube ads?
faq.a: Follow Google's current ad-review and disclosure rules on the day you publish. We do not submit the ad, and we do not guarantee approval.

faq.q: Can the same tall file run somewhere else?
faq.a: A 9:16 file can be tried in other tall placements, but preview it in each player. The buttons sit in different places, so check the product each time.
Use [social media ad sizes](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform) before you export, and keep the product clear of the player controls.

reviews.h2: How shops open a Shorts test before filming
reviews.lead: A few ways shops use one upload.

items.d: A kitchen shop uses a pan photo for one cook motion, with the handle kept visible.
A beauty shop uses a gloss photo for a swatch, with the tube still in frame.
An electronics shop uses an earbud case photo for an open-case hold.
A drink seller uses a can photo for a short pour, with the label facing the camera.
A home shop uses a lamp photo for a switch-on, so the shade shape is easy to see.
A fitness shop uses a mat photo for an unroll, so the length is easy to see.
